entities.name: Collective Mobilization for Change
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Organized efforts by groups of people to alter existing governance arrangements, expand participation, or achieve self-rule. From English Parliamentarians challenging royal prerogative to mass mobilizations on every continent, collective action has been the primary engine through which societies have reshaped their governing structures over the past five centuries.
